gurwi-learn-anything.title: Gurwi – Learn Anything · Shipaton | Shipaton Showcase
paras:
Learn anything in an easy, visual, interactive way — or type a prompt and Gurwi builds the full lesson for you.

CREATE AI LESSONS AND COURSES
Ask for a lesson on photosynthesis, history, personal finance, English or any topic. Gurwi generates complete lessons and courses with units, lessons and content ready to study on your phone.

A FORMAT BUILT FOR LEARNING
Lessons combine text, images, quizzes, diagrams, timelines, interactive cards, audio and visualizations. Study in scroll mode or step by step.

TAP WORDS AND LEARN LANGUAGES
Tap any word to see its meaning in context, save it to your vocabulary and review it later. Any lesson becomes a language-learning experience.

NOW IN 30+ LANGUAGES
The Gurwi app is available in more than 30 languages, and you can generate content to study in many more.

WHO IT'S FOR
Students, self-learners, curious minds, educators, children and adults.

Terms of Service: https://gurwi.com/terms

echo-reminder.title: Voice Reminder Planner: Echo · Shipaton | Shipaton Showcase
paras:
Echo — Key features:
• Voice Reminders: Speak naturally; Echo pulls out the task, due date, and time—no typing.
• Free, No Ads: Focus on your day—not paywalls or clutter.
• Multi-task input: Say several tasks at once; Echo splits and schedules each correctly.
• Multilingual friendly: Mix languages in one sentence and Echo still understands.
• Clean views: Today & Upcoming at a glance; separate Overdue and Completed for quick triage.
• Timely reminders: Stay on track with on-time notifications.
• Custom repeats: Set flexible schedules (e.g., weekdays, every 3 days, every 8 hours).
• Notes & priorities: Add notes to any reminder and set color-coded priority levels.
• Smart AI: Add research, web search, and drafting capabilities to reminders.

dayloop-everyday-timelapse.title: Dayloop: Photo Journal · Shipaton | Shipaton Showcase
paras: It’s a small thing: download the app and spend a few minutes with it. If it clicks with you, leave a rating and a short review. That little bit of attention can genuinely make a maker’s day.

Take a photo every day. Track your progress. Create memories.

- Selfies
- Muscle gain
- Pregnancy
- Growth of a kid
- Weight loss
- Growth of a pet
- Travel pics
- Any transformation you imagine. Be creative!

Dayloop takes all the hassle out of creating a timelapse video. No video editing skills required.

- AUTOMATIC PHOTO ALIGNMENT
The app magically aligns face or full-body photos: perfect for selfie series or tracking physical transformations.

- TRANSLUCENT PHOTO OVERLAY
When taking a new photo, you’ll see a translucent overlay of the previous one to help you match the framing just right.

- TIME TRAVEL
Travel through time with an interactive slider that lets you explore your timelapse.

- IMPORT EXISTING PHOTOS
Already have a set of selfies or progress pics? Start a new timelapse using photos from your camera roll. 
- DAILY REMINDERS
Turn on notifications and never forget to add a photo to your timelapse. 
- PRIVACY
All your photos stay on your device. Nothing is uploaded, shared, or sent anywhere. Your data stays yours.

 Need more than one sequence? Subscribe to PRO!

pitchlab-professional-grade-baseball-pit.title: PitchLab - Baseball & Softball · Shipaton | Shipaton Showcase
paras: It’s a small thing: download the app and spend a few minutes with it. If it clicks with you, leave a rating and a short review. That little bit of attention can genuinely make a maker’s day.

PitchLab turns your iPhone into a professional-grade pitch tracking system, no extra hardware required. Improve your pitching instantly with data. Break down your bullpen sessions, see pitch-by-pitch analysis, and get pro-level metrics.

Built by AI/Computer Vision expert Dr. Brian Martin and MLB player Jake Fishman, PitchLab delivers professional-grade pitch data using a single iPhone camera that has competitive accuracy to radar based technology.

Core Features
• Track Pitch Velocity – Get precise readings without a radar gun.
• Measure Vertical & Horizontal Break – Understand exactly how your pitches move.
• Active Spin & Spin Axis – See how the spin of your throw affects the movement.
• Automatically Trim Video – We automatically detect every throw and trim the video around it.
• Real Time - Our algorithm operates in real time, giving you results immediately after you throw
• Tracer Overlay - We automatically add a tracer overlay to clearly show how the ball moves
• Export Sessions - Export your entire session as one video for easily playback and sharing
• Session Review – Swipe through the video feed to watch back your bullpen.
• Performance Tracking – Monitor progress over time and set measurable goals.

INDIVIDUALS
Use PitchLab to track velocity, movement, and spin in real time. Review video of every pitch, share highlights on social media, and get the insights you need to improve your arsenal.

COACHES & FACILITIES
Automatically track your players’ pitch metrics and video. Analyze trends over time to objectively pinpoint areas for improvement. Automatically see video and data from clients training remotely. Ability to create more pitcher profiles and track data for each pitcher you coach.

Backed by Pros
Never before have pitchers been able to get advanced analytics without spending thousands on radar-based hardware. With PitchLab, every player can get the data that has shaped so many big-league careers, anywhere they train.

Privacy Policy: https://pitchlab.app/privacy
Terms of Service: https://pitchlab.app/terms
